Definition: to bake (round cakes on the hearth)
BiblicalUsage: ʻûwg stands behind the English phrase to bake round cakes. In Ezekiel 4:12, thou shalt eat it as barley cakes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the cakes Ezekiel baked over dung tell me how far God will go to show His people their uncleanness.
